headline: After backlash, Meta pauses plan to ‘rate limit’ its smart glasses
summary: Meta has halted plans to charge a monthly fee for a smart glasses feature. The controversial plan involved a $20 subscription for a local audio clarity feature. Backlash from users prompted the company's decision.

headline: Meta just created a moderation nightmare for its smart glasses
summary: Meta's smart glasses face severe public backlash over privacy concerns. Users are exploiting the glasses to film unsuspecting individuals for 'prank' content. This has led to a major moderation challenge for the company.

headline: Qualcomm is about to raise prices and that’s bad news for everyone
summary: Qualcomm announced plans to increase prices for its products by 'double digits.' The price hikes take effect after September 1st due to rising supplier costs. This move is expected to negatively impact consumers and manufacturers.

headline: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
summary: AI startup Midjourney has acquired the personalized astrology app Co-Star. The move signals Midjourney's expansion into new fields beyond AI image generation. Co-Star offers daily horoscopes and cosmic insights.

headline: Spaceballs: The New One Creators on Making Mel Brooks' Yogurt CGI and Paying Tribute to John Candy | Comic Con 2026
summary: Rick Moranis and Josh Gad revealed details for 'Spaceballs: The New One' at SDCC 2026. Mel Brooks' character Yogurt will be CGI, and the film will honor John Candy. The movie features new Star Wars gags.

headline: God of War Laufey Release Date Announced | Comic Con 2026
summary: 'God of War Laufey' has officially received a release date. The game is set to launch on February 16, 2027. The announcement was made at Comic Con 2026.

headline: Next Kratos-Led God of War Game Is Coming After Laufey, and Connects Directly to Her Story | Comic Con 2026
summary: A new Kratos-led God of War game is confirmed to follow 'God of War Laufey.' Santa Monica Studio head Cory Barlog states it directly connects to Laufey's narrative. The announcement came during Comic Con 2026.

headline: American Caper From Absurd Ventures' Dan Houser Is Getting a Double-Sized Season Finale Issue #12 - Exclusive | Comic Con 2026
summary: Dan Houser's 'American Caper' comic series is getting a double-sized season finale. Issue #12 will be released on November 11, 2026. IGN exclusively revealed the news at Comic Con 2026.

headline: More than 220,000 evacuated in France and Spain due to wildfires
summary: Over 220,000 people have been evacuated due to widespread wildfires. Firefighters are battling blazes near Bordeaux, France. Madrid faces its 'worst fire in history,' according to officials.

headline: Gangs, violence and dumped dead animals: The hidden world of illegal hare hunts
summary: Farmers report attacks amid a surge in illegal hare coursing incidents. Police have received nearly 9,000 reports of banned hunts. The BBC investigation reveals a grim reality of gangs and animal dumping.

headline: Police declare 'major incident' as wind change increases Cairngorms wildfire risk
summary: Police declared a 'major incident' as wind changes escalate Cairngorms wildfire risk. All residents in Nethy Bridge village have been evacuated. The wildfire poses a significant threat of spreading further.

headline: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
summary: Donald Trump criticized the press at the White House Correspondents' Dinner. The event celebrated press freedom following a prior cancellation. It was the first dinner after a shooting in April.
